note: Test-id ledger for the engine-split Phase 1 batch 1d, built against the batch base 0fa3b66fc (main after 1b). Ids are relative to each collection's ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --before <before-matrix.json>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <before-scripts.json>=<base> --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --after <after-matrix.json>=tools/matrix --after <after-scripts.json>=. --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f> <files>` (--isolate on BOTH sides: batch 1b review m4), from the engine package for the engine report and from the repo root with the engine's vitest binary for the other two. Task 1d-0 (scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs compares ids as a multiset, commit 497849e76): scripts/__tests__/test-parity.test.ts, collected whole on both sides; the two tests that asserted a duplicate id is refused are retired (behaviour deliberately reversed) and the multiset tests are added. Task 1d-1 (Stryker tests and stryker-changed.mjs layout-agnostic): engine = the eleven test/stryker-*.test.ts files (outputs-ignored, sizing, changed-lines, matrix, cuts, floor, generator-exclusion, groups, runner, sandbox-safe, vitest-runner), tools/matrix = __tests__/matrix-workflow.test.ts. No moved test changed its title except the split fan-out test of stryker-sizing.test.ts (retitled 'the workflow quotes' for the engine half; the matrix-workflow.test.ts half is a new test in that file). The enginePrefix test is the only added engine test. Later tasks of batch 1d append their own entries to this file.
